MSVC rule: caller builds the copy, CALLEE destroys it: Completed calls juce::BigInteger::~BigInteger(r9 pointer) at its end (0x14256654a, single exit path) — the Windows handleDBMessageTrackStatus 0x142565c20 copy-constructs (0x142565d3c) and passes the copy without destroying it afterwards (it destroys only its own incoming by-value param at 0x142565d57). So the mod must NOT call A_bigIntFree after the call on Windows (mac: caller frees, since mac handleDBMessageTrackStatus calls the dtor after the call). A double free would be harmless here only because a default BigInteger has a null heap ptr and ~BigInteger is free(null), but skip it. The mod's own param is read-only in Completed (only BigInteger::operator[](0) at 0x142565def). long is 32-bit on MSVC and is ignored by the callee anyway; the mod passes 2 which the mac handleDBMessageTrackStatus test (bit 1) wants; keep the type as 'long' or int — either works. Also: Completed also expects the player object (rcx) at the same pointer as handleDBMessageTrackStatus (no this adjustment seen: it forwards rcx unchanged)
